    Extensions of quiver representations #

    For representations X, Y of a finite quiver and maps z_α : X(s α) → Y(t α), the extension E(z) has spaces Y(i) × X(i) and arrows (y, x) ↦ (Y(α) y + z_α x, X(α) x) (extR). A path acts on E(z) by a block-triangular operator whose off-diagonal block is cross z l (πY_pathTot), which is additive and homogeneous in z (cross_add, cross_smul).
